$comment: Single source of truth for the JS<->WASM ABI: packed-snapshot field layouts, shared enums, and the version stamp. `npm run generate:abi` emits cpp/engine/abi.generated.hpp and wasmBridge/abi.generated.js; the wasm build fails if they are stale. Bump abiVersion on ANY layout/enum change — initSandWasm() refuses a module whose engine_abi_version() mismatches, which catches stale committed sandEngine artifacts immediately.

playerSnapshot.$comment: float32 records built by buildPlayerSnapshot (player.inc); read by engineFactory.getPlayers/getPlayer and the net layer.

itemSnapshot.$comment: float32 records built by buildItemSnapshot (items.inc); also the external GL item layout (glSetItems) and the ITEMS wire message payload.

creatureSnapshot.$comment: float32 creature records built by CreatureSystem; also used by the external GL renderer and CREATURES wire message.

inventorySlot.$comment: float32 records built by buildInventorySnapshot / buildCursorSnapshot (inventory.inc). The cursor snapshot uses the same layout with `selected` unused.

projectileSnapshot.$comment: float32 projectile records used by the authority, network, and external GL renderer.

craftingRecipe.$comment: int32 recipe headers; ingredientStart/count index craftingIngredient records.

craftingIngredient.$comment: int32 recipe ingredients: kind selects exact material or material flag.

glPlayerExt.$comment: float32 records a multiplayer client packs for engine_gl_set_players (host-authoritative snapshot players).

soundEvent.$comment: float32 semantic audio events drained from the authoritative engine. Coordinates are absolute world cells so streaming cannot move a queued sound.

perfSnapshot.$comment: double records written by engine_perf_snapshot. Fine step phases accumulate across both layers; counts are totals for the last step. Bump abiVersion on layout change.

PlayerInput.$comment: Input bitmask (player.inc / the browser input layer / the net protocol).

InventoryItemKind.$comment: Inventory/world-drop stack identity. Empty stacks are represented by count=0.

ProjectileKind.$comment: Projectile actor kind used by simulation snapshots and render/network mirrors.

CraftIngredientKind.$comment: How a crafting ingredient value is interpreted.

Tool.$comment: Legacy tool ids (tools.inc); the creative palette prefers setCreativeMaterial.

CreativeKind.$comment: What an engine_set_creative_material selection refers to.

CreatureSpecies.$comment: Creature species ids used by snapshots, test hooks, and the network renderer.

CreatureAttackState.$comment: Replicated enemy telegraph/fire state used by simulation, transport, and GL presentation.

SoundEventType.$comment: Semantic game sounds. The engine reports what happened; the browser audio mixer owns synthesis, spatialization, and voice policy.

constants.$comment: Shared scalar constants. INV_SLOTS must equal INV_HOTBAR + the grid size (asserted in common.hpp).
